title: RapidMeta Cardiology | HFrEF GDMT network: all-cause mortality (audit-first, full-functionality)
hero_h2: HFrEF — all-cause mortality across the guideline-directed therapy network

pico.pop: Adults with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) enrolled in randomized trials of guideline-directed medical therapy
pico.int: Guideline-directed medical therapy components and combinations as network nodes: ACEI, ARB, ARNI, beta-blocker, MRA, SGLT2i
pico.comp: Placebo, usual care, or another guideline-directed therapy node (per included trial)
pico.subgroup: By therapy node/combination and trial era (see evidence table)
